title: Intelligent Career Guidance and Resume Optimization Platform Using AI unifies...

name: Content Placeholder 2
text: Intelligent Career Guidance and Resume Optimization Platform Using AI unifies student career preparation in a React/Spring Boot platform. Deterministic ATS-oriented scoring is separated from Gemini qualitative feedback. Job matching combines skill coverage, TF-IDF/cosine, experience, education, and optional semantic similarity. Ten-question assessment snapshots are timed and graded server-side. Students can start now or manage their own schedules. Review-2 evidence supports approximately 72% completion; notifications, proctoring, deployment, and advanced personalization remain planned.

name: literature-comparison
text:
STUDY / METHOD / LIMITATION
Reusens et al. (2018) — labor-market recommenders — reciprocity beyond accuracy; no preparation loop
Skills2Job (2021) — embeddings + graph — occupation recommendation only
Kadam et al. (2022) — NLP resume screening — recruiter-centric ranking
CoBERT (2023) — contextual student employability — no integrated assessment workflow
ICSSAS (2023) — GNN + NER + TF-IDF/cosine — no timed practice loop
JobEdKG / CARIA (2024) — skills, courses and competency gaps — domain-specific recommendation
AI & Society (2025) — generative screening bias — supports bounded, transparent AI use
